_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The August 2024 analog is 75.8% similar but lacks the ETF flow and stablecoin growth catalysts that powered the prior recovery, so the coil persists with no visible breaker to justify a directional call.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both see the bottom analog and agree on HOLD direction, but they split on current phase (Analyst: Disbelief, Narrative: Denial) and on whether the analog has enough fuel to climb; the analyst's higher trust weight (7.67 vs 6.00) and factor-level evidence of missing institutional bid tips the reconciliation toward the analyst's caution, while the phase is anchored to Denial where the Fear & Greed at 28 and momentum collapse actually sit on the ladder.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows re-emerge above 30 and stablecoin growth turns positive, breaking the coil upward toward Disbelief
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 80 or Fear & Greed drops below 20, flushing Denial into Capitulation
